title: French Crouton Salad
description: A simple yet flavorful salad made with crunchy croutons and topped with a variety of fresh ingredients.

ingredients.name: Crunchy ingredients
ingredients.notes: such as chopped nuts or seeds

instructions: 2. Toss bread cubes with 1 tablespoon olive oil and season with salt. Spread on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
3. In a large bowl, combine salad mix, toasted bread cubes, and crunchy ingredients.
4. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
